lead: Jiddu Krishnamurti was a philosopher, born on 12 May 1895 in Madanapalle.
He died on 17 February 1986 in Ojai at the age of 90.
He is associated with work such as Freedom from the Known, The First and Last Freedom and Commentaries on Living and has been recognised with the United Nations Peace Medal.
The sections that follow break down Jiddu Krishnamurti's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Jiddu Krishnamurti — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Jiddu Krishnamurti was born on 12 May 1895 in Madanapalle, and holds citizenship of British Raj, India and Dominion of India.
Public records name his mother, Annie Besant.
He studied at Paris-Sorbonne University - Paris IV.
He is recorded as speaking Telugu and English.

sections.heading: Jiddu Krishnamurti — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists philosopher as his main occupation.
Among the credits most often linked to Jiddu are Freedom from the Known, The First and Last Freedom, Commentaries on Living and Krishnamurti Foundation.
